terms.quote: Issuer: | Citigroup Global Markets Holdings Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Citigroup Inc.
Pricing Supplement No. 2026-USNCH34154
Underlying: | Boston Scientific Corporation
The underlying shares of Boston Scientific Corporation trade on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “BSX.”
Initial underlying value: | $44.68, the closing value of the underlying on the pricing date
The closing value of Boston Scientific Corporation on September 24, 2026 was $44.68.
The closing value of Boston Scientific Corporation on September 24, 2026 was $44.68.
Underlying: | Boston Scientific Corporation
Stated principal amount: | $1,000 per security
Pricing date: | September 24, 2026
Issue date: | September 29, 2026
Maturity date: | October 28, 2027
Valuation date: | October 25, 2027, subject to postponement if such date is not a scheduled trading day or certain market disruption events occur

If the final underlying value is less than the final barrier value, you will lose 1% of the stated principal amount of your securities for every 1% by which the final underlying value is less than the initial underlying value.
Final barrier value: | $26.808, 60.00% of the initial underlying value
Final underlying value: | The closing value of the underlying on the valuation date
Guarantee: | All payments due on the securities are fully and unconditionally guaranteed by Citigroup Inc.
CUSIP / ISIN: | 17334DBW1 / US17334DBW11
On the date of this pricing supplement, the estimated value of the securities is $971.60 per security, which is less than the issue price.
CGMI will pay selected dealers not affiliated with CGMI a variable selling concession of up to $19.40 for each security they sell.
Digital return amount: | $119.00 per security (representing a digital return equal to 11.90% of the stated principal amount).
